newsitem.title: USA: Madge cites system sales for Q2 weakness.
newsitem.headline: Madge cites system sales for Q2 weakness.

text.p: SAN JOSE, Calif., Madge Networks Inc Wednesday said its second quarter earnings suffered from weak system products sales, leading to earnings that fell below expectations.

Madge reported a second quarter loss of $0.15 a share on sales of $102 million versus a loss of $0.12 a share on $112 million in sales last year. Analysts' consensus estimate was for a loss of $0.09 a share, according to First Call.
"We under performed against our plans," Robert Madge, chief executive officer, said in a statement. "We were impeded by weakness in system product sales, especially in the Americas."
Madge said the company's change to a Value Added Reseller (VAR) sales model has not yet produced revenue results.
On a positive note, Madge said its adapter card volumes rose during the quarter and video networking sales improved.
Madge is a maker of computer networking products.
